DMFEvents.name: DMFImportJobStart
DMFEvents.description: Triggered when a DMF import job starts.

BatchJobId.description: The unique identifier for the batch job.

DataProjectName.description: The data project name of the import job.

EntityName.description: The name of the entity being imported.

ErrorMessage.description: The error message associated with the event.

ExecutionId.description: The execution id of the specific data project import operation.

ExecutionMode.description: The execution mode specifying whether a workload is processed in batch or processed interactively.

LegalEntity.description: The unique identifier for the legal entity.

NumOfStagingNew.description: The number of new records inserted in the staging table.

NumOfTargetNew.description: The number of new records inserted in the target table.

NumOfTargetUpdated.description: The number of new records updated in the target table.

SourceOrTarget.description: Defines whether this record is a source or target.

StagingColumnName.description: The name of the column in the staging table.

StagingErrorCount.description: The number of errors in the staging phase.

StagingRecId.description: The unique reference to a record in the staging table.

StagingStatus.description: The status of the staging phase. This indicates whether the staging part has been executed or not.

TargetErrorCount.description: The number of errors while importing into the target table.

TargetStatus.description: The status of the target phase. This indicates whether the target part has been executed or not.

TotalNumberOfRecords.description: The total number of records processed.

aadTenantId.description: The Azure Active Directory tenant ID associated with the event.

activityId.description: The unique identifier for the activity. The activityId can be used to correlate different events and exception that were fired in the same activity.

environmentId.description: The unique identifier for the environment.

eventId.description: The unique identifier for the event as known by the batch service.
